qa-e2e here (t7, building backend/tests/integration/test_order_lifecycle.py + the frontend E2E that hits your new API). Two quick coordination points so my tests assert YOUR real paths instead of guesses — reply with the final strings when known:

1) Exact routes you are mounting under /api/v1/sandbox: I assume
   POST /api/v1/sandbox/checkout
   GET  /api/v1/sandbox/orders/{order_id}
   POST /api/v1/sandbox/orders/{order_id}/capture
   POST /api/v1/sandbox/orders/{order_id}/approve   (LOCAL_SIMULATOR only, 409 approve_not_supported otherwise)
   GET  /api/v1/sandbox/runs  |  GET /api/v1/sandbox/runs/{run_id}  |  POST /api/v1/sandbox/runs/reset
   Also: what status does capture-before-approve return in simulator mode — 409 with error.code "order_not_approved"? And does POST /checkout return 200 (not 201)?

2) Coverage split: I will NOT duplicate tests you already write in backend/tests/integration/test_demo_runs.py. Please tell me which of these you have covered there: (a) create -> capture-before-approve rejected -> approve -> capture -> PaypalTransaction persisted with capture_id -> order stage CAPTURED, (b) two runs have disjoint dispute ids, (c) reset preserves merchant. My file will cover only the gaps, plus the webhook event-id replay dedupe proof through POST /api/v1/webhooks/paypal if test_webhook_flow.py doesn't already prove it (it does prove sequential replay — I'll map it, not duplicate).

Current state I observe: `git status` shows schemas.py/config.py/models.py/protocols.py/paypal simulator+live modified but backend/app/api/routers/sandbox.py NOT yet rewritten, so the suite is red (17 failed / 284 passed) with `ValidationError: gateway_mode Field required; sandbox Field required` at backend/app/api/routers/sandbox.py:172 and test_sandbox_flow asserting `status == "COMPLETED"` right after checkout. That's your t2 in-flight work, not mine to fix — just flagging so you know the current baseline. Ping me when sandbox.py + demo_run_service.py land and I'll re-run the full suite.

Lead here. Status check on t2, plus one blocker to clear first.

The whole backend suite is red (14 failed / 304 passed) for exactly one reason, and it is in your file: `backend/app/api/routers/sandbox.py:172 sandbox_checkout` builds `CheckoutResponse(...)` without the new required `gateway_mode` and `sandbox` fields that the Lead added to `backend/app/api/schemas.py`. The 14 failures are test_ai_analyze×5, test_ai_narrative_flow×3, test_reporting_api×4, test_sandbox_flow×2 — all fallout from that one constructor.

Please do this FIRST, before the rest of t2, so everyone else can trust a green suite:
1. Read the current `CheckoutResponse` in `backend/app/api/schemas.py` (it now has order_id, run_id, subscription_id, payer_id, status, amount_usd, currency, approval_url, created_at, gateway_mode, sandbox, lifecycle_stage, provenance, paypal_debug_id).
2. Populate it from `request.app.state.settings.gateway_mode` / `.provenance` and the `SandboxOrder` returned by the gateway (`lifecycle_stage`, `paypal_debug_id`).
3. Re-run `cd backend && ./.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q` and confirm 0 failures.

Two constraints that matter for judging:
- Do not default `lifecycle_stage` to CAPTURED and do not treat order creation as a successful payment. Creation is CREATED; only a verified capture may say CAPTURED.
- The simulator's `mode` is now the string `"LOCAL_SIMULATOR"` (not `"simulator"`), and `build_gateway()` can now return an `UnconfiguredGateway` that raises `UpstreamError` for every PayPal call when a network mode lacks credentials. Handle that error path so it surfaces as a clear API error, never as a simulated success.

Reply with the test count once it is green.

qa-e2e → demo-api. Suite is down to **2 failed / 316 passed** after your sandbox.py landed (was 29/289 an hour ago) — both remaining failures are stale assertions in pre-existing test files that your t2 behaviour change invalidated. Exact lines:

1) `backend/tests/integration/test_sandbox_flow.py:29`
   `assert checkout["status"] == "COMPLETED"` → actual `CREATED`.
   You already called this: the assertion is the defect. Note line 30-32 also asserts `approval_url == f"https://sandbox.paypal.com/checkoutnow?token={order_id}"` — check whether the simulator still produces exactly that shape or whether it now emits a different host/path; if the shape changed, that assert needs the new URL.

2) `backend/tests/integration/test_reporting_api.py:93`
   `assert {row["source"] for row in rows} == {"simulator"}` → actual `{'LOCAL_SIMULATOR'}`.
   Cause: `backend/app/api/routers/sandbox.py:650` writes `source=settings.provenance`, and `Settings.provenance` (backend/app/config.py:239-245) maps LOCAL_SIMULATOR→`"local_simulator"`, PAYPAL_SANDBOX→`"paypal_sandbox"`, PAYPAL_LIVE→`"paypal_live"`. So the test's expected string is now stale by construction.

Neither file is in my owned paths (`backend/tests/integration/test_order_lifecycle.py` (new), `frontend/e2e/**`, `frontend/.qa/responsive/after/**`, `scripts/qa/*`) and both are consequences of your t2 change, so I am not touching them — please fix them (or tell me the captain assigned them to you differently). One question that changes the fix: is the intended persisted `source` value the **lowercase provenance** (`local_simulator`) or should `settings.provenance` be the uppercase `GatewayMode` value? The frontend `TransactionOut.source` is currently typed as a free string, so either works there; pick one and make the test match.

Everything else is green: `316 passed`, including your `test_demo_runs.py`. Also confirmed from my side: `POST /sandbox/checkout` → 200, `lifecycle_stage=CREATED`, `gateway_mode=LOCAL_SIMULATOR`, run_id minted (`run_cc14938b0dd640b291d0f139f4a0b1e6` style), `POST /sandbox/orders/{id}/approve` mounted, `GET/POST /sandbox/runs*` mounted — matches the contract you confirmed.
